findings.text: follow-on: the fragment tells the reader the correction travels in 'the message of the repair commit that follows it', but that message (4a181b69f) itself states the correction is recorded 'in a note on that commit' (526870857); `git notes show 526870857` and `git notes show 4a181b69f` both report 'no note found', and a note would not travel with an ordinary push anyway, so the pointer chain ends at nothing and the bump commit's wrong locator is corrected by no note. The correction is nonetheless substantively present in 4a181b69f's message body, so a reader still learns the right group.

follow-on: the corrected locator prose is guarded by no test. The node's own control (isn-pin-0-10-1-fix-locator-check.log) shows the arms flip on a revert (base 0 / head 1 for 'dev group under'; 1 / 0 for the old 'extra of' wording), but it is a one-off grep that no gate re-runs, so a later edit reintroducing the wrong group would not redden anything.
